question: What will be the largest number of Chinese aircraft violating Taiwan's air defense identification zone (ADIZ) in a single day during November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: PLATracker monthly maximum of daily 'Total Aircraft Tracked in ADIZ', Sep 2025-Sep 2026; 2026 months ranged 17-32 with median 24; Oct 2026 so far peaks at only 13. Monthly spikes come from joint combat readiness patrols (typically 15-30 in ADIZ). Nov 2026 contains APEC Shenzhen (Nov 18-19) with a planned Trump-Xi meeting, which argues for restraint, and October activity has been subdued; a counterweight is rising maritime pressure and the chance of a patrol before or after the summit. Tail above 45.5 needs a named large-scale drill (none since Dec 2025, which hit 90), priced ~4%. No human prediction market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold for this question; only unrelated invasion and travel-advisory markets.

calls.reasoning: Anchor: 2026 PLATracker monthly maxima of ADIZ aircraft 19,32,24,20,24,25,26,17,24 (median 24); Nov 2025 = 31. Recent tempo is lower (Aug 17, Oct-to-date 13) and Nov contains China-hosted APEC with a Trump-Xi meeting, arguing restraint, so the median is shaded to ~20-21. JCRPs (1-3/month, 15-30 in ADIZ) set the peak; Nov 28 Taiwan local elections are a mild upside trigger. Tail >45.5 requires a named large drill (~1-2/yr, none since Dec 2025), priced 5% given the summit. No human market found per runs (no web access this run).
calls.reconciliation: Factual dispute: Run 2 said the PLATracker sheet has data only through mid-2025; Runs 1 and 3 each separately cite matching monthly maxima through Oct 16 2026 (e.g., Sep26 24, Oct26 13, Dec25 90), so I accept that the sheet is current. The MND fallback gives similar magnitudes, so this hardly matters. Run 2's lower monthly peaks (Jul 22, Oct 21) likely mix ADIZ and total-sortie figures from weekly summaries; I used the sheet values. The remaining disputes are judgment: how much to weight the subdued Aug-Oct tempo and APEC restraint (I shade the median below the 24 base rate to ~20.5) and the size of the drill tail (5%, between Runs 1/2 at 3-4% and Run 3 at 8%, because named drills run ~1-2/yr but the summit month lowers the odds). Run 1's dispersion of ~16-18 is carried forward.
